subject: Seamless onboarding - request for a short preservation credit while PO processes
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novamed.com>
Cc: Priyanka Singh <pri.singh@novamed.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Seamless onboarding - request for a short preservation credit while PO processes

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the product team was excited by the initial results and Priyanka reminded me the procurement PO is mid-review. Understandable timing.

To avoid losing onboarding momentum (we’ve scheduled your integration kickoff for 11/17), would Novamed be open to a short, conditional credit to keep the sandbox and CI pipeline warm while purchasing clears? Specifically: a one-time $300 credit (roughly 5k generations / equivalent) valid for 7 days.

We’d attach a short addendum that makes the credit conditional on the PO being submitted within 10 business days — no billing until PO clears. If that sounds workable, I’ve attached a one-page MVP onboarding plan and our compliance checklist so your security team can validate quickly.

Proposed next steps:
- You approve the provisional credit amount and timeframe (reply ok)
- We issue the credit and confirm the sandbox expiry date
- Your procurement submits the PO; we convert/offset the credit against the first invoice once PO completes

Happy to hop on a quick call if you want to walk through the details.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: MVP-onboarding-plan.pdf (application/pdf), compliance-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Samir Patel <samir@novamed.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyanka Singh <pri.singh@novamed.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Seamless onboarding - request for a short preservation credit while PO processes

Rachel —

Thanks for flagging this. Procurement has indeed paused on the PO while finance completes a vendor review; it could be 5–8 business days. We want to avoid the team losing momentum.

Couple of quick questions: 1) Can you confirm exactly what the $300 covers (tokens / seats / API calls)? 2) Are there any legal/compliance implications for Novamed for this kind of provisional credit?

If it’s a small, time-limited sandbox credit and you include the compliance checklist, I think we can push for an internal thumbs-up — Priyanka, can you advise?

—Samir
Director of Engineering, Novamed

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novamed.com>
Cc: Priyanka Singh <pri.singh@novamed.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Seamless onboarding - request for a short preservation credit while PO processes

Thanks Samir — quick answers below and happy to provide anything your team needs for procurement/finance: 

1) What $300 covers: a one-time account credit applied to the hosted sandbox. Estimated capacity: ~5,000 short-form generations or 10,000 embed units (exact mapping depends on call patterns). We’ll provide a simple ledger so you can see token usage while the credit is active.

2) Legal/compliance: there are no additional licensing requirements — this is a promotional account credit issued by Redwood. The compliance-checklist.xlsx lists data handling and retention behaviors; we can also run your security team through our SOC 2 evidence if needed.

If Novamed approves, we’ll: 1) issue the credit with a 7-day expiry, 2) require a one-line acceptance from Samir or Priyanka confirming procurement is in progress, and 3) include the credit as an offset on the first invoice if PO clears within 10 business days.

Camila — can you queue the 7-day $300 provisional credit and note the constraint that it’s convertible against NVMD-2026-087 if PO comes through? Neha, any other guardrails you want added?

Thanks — I’ll stand by for Priyanka’s go/no-go.

Best,
Rachel

Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Seamless onboarding - request for a short preservation credit while PO processes

Thanks Rachel — I reviewed the request and the compliance checklist. We can approve a one-time, 72-hour voucher up to $350 for Novamed under the following conditions:

- Voucher is time-limited (72 hours) and non-renewing automatically
- Novamed must reply with a brief procurement status confirmation (one-line OK from Samir or Priyanka)
- Voucher will be recorded against deal NVMD-2026-087 and offset on the first invoice if PO completes within 10 business days
- If the PO does not arrive within 10 business days, voucher balance will be forfeited and we’ll close the sandbox environment

Camila — please provision the voucher for Novamed and add a note in HubSpot (company ID 67890). Rachel — please request Samir/Priyanka’s acceptance.

Neha Kapoor
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
